messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: saw a reproducible token substitution when we hit a wraparound on the KV index during a shard-swap in the int4 bringup. Prefill=120k, then a steady stream of 8-token continuations, and at swap we get 2-token weirdness.

Jin: Can you paste the minimal repro and which model build?

Ravi: model: magnet-7b-int4v2 (onboard branch). Run command:
```bash
./serve_local --model magnet-7b-int4v2 --ctx 262144 --kv-shard-swap true --prefill-file long_prompt_120k.txt --cont-step 8 --seed 7
```
Output snippet: 
```text
[01:02:10] prefill complete tokens=120000
[01:02:56] live-cont token=\"the\"
[01:02:57] after shard-swap (kv index reset) returned=\"tha\"
[01:02:58] next token aligned back to baseline but 2 tokens earlier mismatch
```

Olga: Odd. So mismatch spans token t and t+1 only around swap? Any diffs in KV metadata?

Ravi: KV metadata dump says indices contiguous, but the per-shard offset used during rotary.apply seems to jump by 2 for that window. I also reproduced with repeated deterministic seeds.

CI Bot: automated test longctx-kv-wrap-120k started (commit: a1c2d3). Artifacts: gs://ci-artifacts/longctx/120k-wrap/1755559999.tar.gz

Jin: Can you test disabling shard-swap (keep single-shard) to confirm it's swap-related?

Ravi: disabled swap, no mismatch after same workload. Re-enabled swap with logging level TRACE on kv-index and got: 
```text
[TRACE] kv-shard-swap: old_offset=120000 new_offset=0 applied_delta=120000
[TRACE] kv-rotary-phase: applied_global_rot_offset=120002
```
So rotary applied 120002 instead of 120000. Looks like a +2 corruption during swap handshake.

Olga: +2 smell like a short/int cast in the handshake code, or a fence ordering where two tokens of prefill are double-applied. Could be in the packing/unpacking path between shards.

Ravi: I ran a narrow bisect: with shard-swap protocol v1 (legacy) no issue; v2 (fast handshake) shows the +2. Suspect delta compression code in v2.

Theo: Proposed quick mitigation: during onboarding/Dedicated canary, force full-replay on swap (disable delta compression) and add a CI guard that runs a 120k prefill + swap smoke to catch regressions.

Jin: I'll add a unit test to the longcontext harness: prefill offsets at 64k, 120k, 200k, with synthetic swaps and compare against fp16 baseline token-by-token. Will also add an assert on applied_global_rot_offset == prefills_total.

Ravi: Reproducer script: tests/repro/kv_swap_wrap_repro.py (seeded). Run it with `--debug-rotary` to get the trace lines above.

Olga: FYI I inspected the delta-compress encode path: there's a codepath that encodes 'num_tokens' into a 16-bit field then later adds a shim offset; if encoded value saturates it wraps. For 120k fits in 16-bit? 120k = 120000 < 65535? actually exceeds. So overflow there. That explains +wrap -> +2.

Jin: Nice catch. So int16 overflow. Fix: change to 32-bit field and add validation in handshake parser.

Ravi: I'll open PR to bump field width and add defensive checks + unit test. Marking P1 for the onboarding pipeline.

CI Bot: created issue #ML-948 on tracker and queued e2e job to run with patched handshake on canary cluster.

Theo: Long-term: add property-based tests for all handshake encodings across range [1..ctx_max]. Also consider using varint encoding to avoid silent overflow.

Ravi: Thanks team. I'll attach logs & mini-repro in the issue. Leaving the env up for anyone who wants to poke: ssh shard-dev-2. :mag:
